title: Finalised per-window multimodal record
description: One row of the finalised testbed dataset. pipeline/align_windows.py windows each device's net/host/tel streams on the board's synced CLOCK_REALTIME grid (window_idx = floor(ts_realtime_ns / W_ns)), outer-joins per (device_id, window_idx), interval-joins the orchestrator's labels.csv, and emits modality_mask + group_id. finalize_dataset.py then ADDS boundary_ambiguous/core_overlap_frac (guard bands), telb__ (per-device benign baseline), cfg_* nuisance metadata, and the split indices. Column-prefix convention (net__/host__/tel__ + __cnt) matches Phase-0 E2b so E1'/E2'/E4' repoints cleanly.

window_idx.description: floor(ts_realtime_ns / W_ns) — same idx == same wall-clock interval on every device (align_windows.py global-epoch anchor)

window_start_iso.description: UTC ISO of the window start on the synced clock

stage.description: interval-joined stage id (stages.yaml S-id); 'normal' when no attack stage covers the window

attack_type.description: coarse attack_type from labels.csv; 'normal' for benign

label_overlap.description: align_windows.py raw-overlap fraction of the window with its stage interval

core_overlap_frac.description: finalize_dataset.py: overlap fraction with the guard-trimmed CORE interval

boundary_ambiguous.description: finalize_dataset.py: window is in a guard band / below min_overlap_frac of CORE; excludable from strict train/eval (P7 boundary-leakage control)

group_id.description: grouped-by-EXECUTION split key (align_windows.py): attack windows '<scenario_id>#<run_idx>'; benign windows 'benign#<device_id>#<time_block>'. GroupKFold on this prevents same-execution windows spanning train/test (P7: up to 0.35 macro-F1).

modality_mask.description: net|host|tel presence, e.g. '111' or '101'; a 0 marks a GENUINELY-absent modality (ipcam has no host logs), so E4' missing-modality is meaningful

net__*.description: network features (Zeek conn/ssh/http/dns/ssl/weird + tcpdump), prefix net__; __cnt = flow count. Identity fields (IPs) dropped (anti-leakage).

host__*.description: host features (auditd execve/connect, auth.log fail/ok counts, journald), prefix host__; __cnt = record count. Names harmonised across armv7/aarch64 (P4).

tel__*.description: device-telemetry features (telemetry_reader.py: cpu/mem/load/thermal/net/disk; INA219 power later), prefix tel__.

telb__*.description: finalize_dataset.py baseline-relative telemetry (tel__ minus per-device benign median, same campaign) — neutralises the P5 device/arch fingerprint

cfg_kernel.description: controlled nuisance metadata from run_manifest (NOT a feature): kernel release
